i1.name: Activated guests
i1.def: Guest sessions with completed access (QR scanned, consents and nickname) in the period, counted once per guest/device.

i2.name: Bonuses redeemed
i2.def: Redemptions = bartender validations not cancelled in the period. Redemption rate = redemptions / bonuses issued. Cost = redemptions × bonus value.

i3.name: Bookings and saturation
i3.def: Confirmed (not cancelled) bookings in the period. Saturation = booked spots / available spots on past slots, per service. No-show is not shown because there is no check-in.

i4.name: Event RSVPs
i4.def: RSVPs = guests who pressed “I'm going”. Attendance is shown only for events with check-in enabled; without check-in, RSVPs are intentions, not attendance.

i5.name: Questions handled by AI
i5.def: Conversations closed without handoff to staff / total conversations. Quality = % of answers marked “wrong” by staff. Hours saved is an estimate (AI answers × minutes per question), not a measured figure.

i6.name: Guests with at least one action
i6.def: % of activated guests who did at least one action among redemption, booking, event RSVP, question to the AI; also shown at 24 h and 72 h after activation.

lim.euro: No indicator measures the increase in spending in euros: the bonus cost is calculated, the revenue is not.
lim.activation: The activation rate is not calculated: it needs the number of guests in the hotel entered by the hotel.
lim.checkin: Event attendance and booking no-shows are not shown: there is no check-in.
lim.i6: Engagement (I6) is calculated only on guests with a still-active stay: after data deletion the link to the person no longer exists.
lim.minutes: Hours saved is an estimate at 3 minutes per question (not yet configurable by the hotel).

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.draft: Technical DRAFT, not a legal text. Must be validated by a lawyer before the pilot. Do not use with real data until ChatHel SRL is incorporated.
privacy.what: Only your first name or nickname, language, the departure date you enter, your bookings, event RSVPs and messages to reception. We do not ask for your surname, room number, documents or location.
privacy.ai: Questions to reception are processed by an automated assistant (non-EU AI provider). Do not write health or sensitive data. For allergies and emergencies talk to the staff.
privacy.retention: On your departure date (or when you press “Sign out and delete my data”) we delete your name, messages, future bookings and unused bonus. Only anonymous counts remain for the hotel.
privacy.people: The guest list, the public chat and private chats exist only for guests who are adults and choose to appear. Other guests only see a first name or nickname and a language: never room, surname, stay dates or contact details. For events only the number of attendees is shown.
privacy.rights: You can delete your data at any time from the Profile. For other requests contact the hotel's reception, the data controller.
privacy.social: You can leave the list, and block or report anyone, at any time. The hotel does not read private chats: if you report a private message, you share with the hotel only that message and at most the 4 before it. Public messages can be hidden by the hotel. At check-out the list, chats, requests and unused coupons are deleted.
